The TESSERAData Class

TESSERAData.Rd

The TESSERAData object is the primary data container for the TESSERA package. Generated by prep_data, it serves as the required input object for downstream model-fitting functions, including TESSERA_lattice and TESSERA_spNNGP. The object organizes multi-sample spatial data—-including coordinates, metadata, count matrices, design matrices, and pre-computed spatial neighborhood matrices and eigenvalues-—into structured, per-sample lists. Pre-computing and storing static quantities (such as adjacency matrices and graph Laplacian eigenvalues) within the TESSERAData object accelerates downstream gene-by-gene model fitting across thousands of genes without redundant computations.

Elements

A TESSERAData object is a structured list containing the following sample-indexed elements:

  • coords_list: List of spatial coordinate matrices (measurements \(\times\) spatial dimensions), one per sample.

  • covariates_list: List of data frames containing sample metadata and cell-level covariates, one per sample.

  • counts_list: List of count matrices (genes \(\times\) measurements), one per sample.

  • library_size_list: List of numeric vectors representing sequencing depth/library sizes (offsets), one per sample.

  • X_list: List of fixed-effect design matrices (measurements \(\times\) parameters), one per sample.

  • W_list: List of sparse binary adjacency matrices (measurements \(\times\) measurements) for lattice models, one per sample.

  • D_list: List of sparse diagonal degree matrices for lattice models, one per sample.

  • eig_CS_list: List of pre-computed eigenvalues for CAR/SAR lattice covariance structures, one per sample (NULL if not computed).

  • eig_L_list: List of pre-computed eigenvalues for Leroux lattice covariance structures, one per sample (NULL if not computed).
